readme:
SEO Skills for Claude Code, Cursor & AI Agents

30 open-source SKILL.md workflows that end in a merged PR or a file in your repo, not an audit PDF.

Web catalog · Install · Skills · Workflows · MCP servers · Sponsors · FAQ

![Terminal install of Illyism/seo-skills, a merged pull request that unblocks Bing and AI crawlers, and rising Google Search Console clicks](assets/seo-skills-hero.jpg) ## Install ```bash # All 30 skills npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills # One skill npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills --skill seo-autopilot # List what is available npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills --list ``` Each skill is a folder with one Markdown `SKILL.md` that follows the [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io). The agent reads only the `name` and `description` at startup and opens the full file when your prompt matches. | Environment | Where `SKILL.md` lives | Install | | --- | --- | --- | | Claude Code | `.claude/skills/` or `~/.claude/skills/` | `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills -a claude-code` | | Cursor | `.cursor/skills/` or `.agents/skills/` | `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills -a cursor` | | Codex, OpenCode, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code | `.agents/skills/` | `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills` | | ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Perplexity, Grok | Paste the Markdown | Copy any skill from [il.ly/skills](https://il.ly/skills) | ## What you get Most SEO prompt packs produce checklists and health scores. Each skill here ends in something you can ship: - **Diffs you can merge:** rewritten titles and H1s, refreshed posts, `robots.txt` and bot rules, verified `301` maps, new `/vs/` routes. - **Proof in place of filler:** `proof-kb`, `seo-blog-images`, and `unslop-seo` swap generic copy for your own benchmarks, screenshots, and charts. - **One page at a time:** `blitz-seo` puts 30 days of fixes, internal links, and backlinks on a single money page. - **Google and AI search together:** map the prompts buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and AI Overviews, track who gets cited, and ship pages for the prompts you are missing. ![Outputs shipped by the skills: a robots.ts crawler fix, a seo/kb/proof folder, a competitor /vs/ pricing page, and ChatGPT and Perplexity citations](assets/seo-skills-output-engine.webp) ## All 30 SEO skills ### Technical, research, and on-page | Skill | What it ships | Example prompt | | --- | --- | --- | | [`seo-autopilot`](seo/seo-autopilot/SKILL.md) | A daily SEO agent for your repo with state in `seo/`: health checks, fact checks against recent commits, page-2 pushes, competitor sitemap diffs, a monthly keyword map | *"Run `seo-autopilot` on this repo and open a PR with today's top fix"* | | [`seo-roast`](seo/seo-roast/SKILL.md) | A blunt teardown that fixes crawl, `robots.txt`, programmatic, layout, and AI-visibility blockers in a PR, then writes `seo/roast-roadmap.md` ordered by revenue | *"Run `seo-roast` on our repo and fix the fatal blockers in a PR"* | | [`blitz-seo`](seo/blitz-seo/SKILL.md) | A 30-day sprint plan to rank one page for one money keyword | *"Run a 30-day `blitz-seo` sprint to push `/pricing` from #14 to the top 3"* | | [`ahrefs-research`](seo/ahrefs-research/SKILL.md) | Ahrefs MCP or API v3 workflows: competitor top-pages gaps (`seo/competitor-gaps.md`) with scaffolded routes, a fake-DR filter (`seo/link-targets.csv`), subreddit topic mining, link-insertion page matching | *"Use `ahrefs-research` to diff our top pages against 5 competitors and scaffold the #1 gap"* | | [`dataforseo-serp`](seo/dataforseo-serp/SKILL.md) | Live SERP workflows: keyword clusters by top-10 URL overlap (`seo/keyword-clusters.json`), a free-tool filter by CPC and volume, AI Overview citation sources, an intent check before you write | *"Use `dataforseo-serp` to cluster these 40 keywords so we don't cannibalize"* | | [`proof-kb`](seo/proof-kb/SKILL.md) | A fact store in `seo/kb/` (brand facts, benchmark and customer proof cards) that drafts pull from, plus `route-fact` to update every page when a number changes | *"Run `proof-kb` init and upgrade `content/blog/postgres-branching.mdx` with our benchmark"* | | [`vs-and-alternatives`](seo/vs-and-alternatives/SKILL.md) | `/vs/[competitor]`, `/[competitor]-alternative`, and "best for [persona]" routes built on sourced switching triggers, seat-based pricing math, and migration steps | *"Use `vs-and-alternatives` to ship `/vs/billstack` and link it from the footer"* | | [`internal-linking`](seo/internal-linking/SKILL.md) | A link-graph audit (`scripts/internal-link-graph.mjs`) and body links from your top posts into `/pricing`, `/vs/*`, and `/tools/*` | *"Run `internal-linking` to fix orphan money pages"* | | [`domain-migration`](seo/domain-migration/SKILL.md) | A rebrand or subdomain-to-subfolder move: full URL and backlink inventory, 1-hop `301` config, `scripts/verify-redirects.sh`, and backlink update emails | *"Run `domain-migration` to move `blog.acme.com` into `acme.com/blog`"* | | [`seo-title-optimization`](seo/seo-title-optimization/SKILL.md) | Title tag, frontmatter `title`, and H1 rewrites checked against the live SERP and truncation limits | *"Audit every page title in `app/` and `content/blog/` for CTR and truncation"* | | [`blog-refresher`](seo/blog-refresher/SKILL.md) | A refresh of a slipping post: compares it with the current top 10 and rewrites the weak sections in your voice | *"Use `blog-refresher` on `content/blog/best-crm.mdx`"* | | [`block-ai-scrapers`](seo/block-ai-scrapers/SKILL.md) | A bot firewall that stops AI agents, `curl`, and headless scrapers from burning API and DB credits, keeps verified Googlebot indexing, and points blocked agents at your product | *"Add `block-ai-scrapers` to protect our `/directory` routes without hurting Googlebot"* | ### AI search (GEO) | Skill | What it ships | Example prompt | | --- | --- | --- | | [`customer-journey`](marketing/customer-journey/SKILL.md) | A 5-stage awareness map with the Google keywords and AI prompts buyers use at each stage | *"Map the `customer-journey` and AI search prompts for our B2B analytics SaaS"* | | [`aiseotracker`](seo/aiseotracker/SKILL.md) | MCP setup for [AI SEO Tracker](https://aiseotracker.com): mentions, citations, and competitors across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and AI Overviews | *"Connect `aiseotracker` and check how ChatGPT and Perplexity rank our domain"* | | [`ai-seo-report`](seo/ai-seo-report/SKILL.md) | A short AI visibility brief from live scans: who gets cited, what changed, what to do | *"Give me this week's `ai-seo-report` and tell me why competitors beat us in ChatGPT"* | | [`content-coverage`](seo/content-coverage/SKILL.md) | A content plan and drafts for the prompt clusters where competitors get cited and you don't | *"Run `content-coverage` for our missing Perplexity and ChatGPT prompts"* | | [`reddit-serp`](seo/reddit-serp/SKILL.md) | A queue (`seo/reddit-serp-queue.md`) of unlocked Reddit threads that rank on page 1 or get cited by AI, with replies written to survive moderation | *"Run `reddit-serp` for our category and draft replies"* | ### Links and directories | Skill | What it ships | Example prompt | | --- | --- | --- | | [`directory-submissions`](seo/directory-submissions/SKILL.md) | One `submission-manifest.json`, the repo files that 15+ MCP and agent registries index, and a 50-directory sequence ([850+ more](https://linkdr.com/resources/directories)) | *"Run `directory-submissions` to build our manifest and submit waves 1-3"* | | [`linkdr`](seo/linkdr/SKILL.md) | A backlink plan for [LinkDR](https://linkdr.com): a DR 30+ to DR 60+ mix for your budget and one checkout link you approve | *"Plan a $1,000 backlink campaign for our homepage with `linkdr`"* | | [`honest-link-outreach`](seo/honest-link-outreach/SKILL.md) | An outreach batch file with a SEND/CUT prospect table and emails that state the ask first and differ in structure | *"Run `honest-link-outreach` on these 8 partner and blog domains"* | | [`awesome-tools`](seo/awesome-tools/SKILL.md) | A submission to [Awesome Tools](https://awesome.tools) over MCP or JSON API for a verified dofollow listing | *"Submit our app to `awesome-tools` and check if we qualify for the free listing"* | ### Content and distribution | Skill | What it ships | Example prompt | | --- | --- | --- | | [`unslop-seo`](content/unslop-seo/SKILL.md) | An in-place edit that grounds vague claims in real facts, puts the answer in the first 40 words, and strips 20 AI writing patterns, with a check script | *"Run `unslop-seo` on `content/blog/ci-guide.mdx`"* | | [`seo-blog-images`](content/seo-blog-images/SKILL.md) | Cover images, screenshots, and SVG charts that are generated, compressed, checked, and wired into the post with filenames, sizes, and alt text | *"Use `seo-blog-images` to add a cover and a benchmark chart to `content/blog/benchmark.mdx`"* | | [`youtube-seo`](content/youtube-seo/SKILL.md) | Titles, a chaptered description, launch posts, and a `VideoObject` embed from a recording or `.srt` | *"Run `youtube-seo` on `demo.srt` and embed the video in the matching post"* | | [`parasite-and-pr`](marketing/parasite-and-pr/SKILL.md) | A syndication bundle in `marketing/distribution//`: a press release with privacy-safe contact fields, a canonicalized Dev.to draft, a LinkedIn article, and a checklist | *"Run `parasite-and-pr` for our 2026 latency benchmark"* | | [`intro`](content/intro/SKILL.md) | Short blog intros matched to listicle, how-to, definition, or debate intent ([examples](content/intro/examples.md)) | *"Rewrite the opening of this post with `intro` for listicle intent"* | | [`scribiz`](content/scribiz/SKILL.md) | Transcripts with speakers, on-screen text, and chapters from video or audio via [Scribiz](https://scribiz.com) | *"Transcribe this YouTube demo with `scribiz` and turn it into a tutorial post"* | | [`diff-marketing`](marketing/diff-marketing/SKILL.md) | Changelog entries, feature articles, and launch posts drafted from recent commits and merged PRs | *"Read the last 2 weeks of commits with `diff-marketing` and draft 3 launch angles"* | ### Copywriting | Skill | What it ships | Example prompt | | --- | --- | --- | | [`understand-customers`](copywriting/understand-customers/SKILL.md) | A buyer research brief: pains, failed alternatives, desired outcome, and the words they use | *"Run `understand-customers` for indie Next.js founders tired of slow CI builds"* | | [`blitz-copy`](copywriting/blitz-copy/SKILL.md) | Landing page, email, and hook copy on the Hook, Spike, Payoff formula | *"Rewrite our hero section and pricing CTAs with `blitz-copy`"* | For engineering skills (AI evals, Chrome Web Store releases), see [Illyism/dev-skills](https://github.com/Illyism/dev-skills). ## End-to-end SEO workflows The skills chain. Six that work well: 1. **Ship a post with first-hand proof.** `dataforseo-serp` (cluster and check intent) → `proof-kb` (add your benchmarks) → `seo-blog-images` → `unslop-seo` → `internal-linking` → `parasite-and-pr`. 2. **Win buyers leaving a competitor.** `ahrefs-research` (diff their top pages) → `vs-and-alternatives` → `reddit-serp` → `honest-link-outreach`. 3. **Push a page-2 URL into the top 3.** `seo-title-optimization` → `blog-refresher` → `intro` → `linkdr` (2-4 DR 40+ links at the refreshed URL). 4. **Get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.** `customer-journey` → `aiseotracker` → `ai-seo-report` → `content-coverage`. 5. **Launch from DR 0.** `understand-customers` → `blitz-copy` → `directory-submissions` and `awesome-tools` → `blitz-seo`. 6. **Daily repo SEO.** Run `seo-autopilot` on a schedule so the agent checks site health, verifies claims against recent commits, and opens PRs. Add `diff-marketing` weekly to turn shipped code into posts. ## Live SEO data via MCP servers A skill is the method. An [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server gives the agent live data to run it on. Three are preconfigured in [`.mcp.json`](.mcp.json): | Server | Endpoint | What it gives the agent | | --- | --- | --- | | [AI SEO Tracker](https://aiseotracker.com) | `https://aiseotracker.com/api/agent/mcp` ([repo](https://github.com/Illyism/aiseotracker-mcp)) | Prompt rankings, cited URLs, and competitor share across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and AI Overviews | | [Scribiz](https://scribiz.com) | `https://scribiz.com/mcp` | Transcripts with speakers, on-screen text, summaries, and chapters | | [Awesome Tools](https://awesome.tools) | `https://awesome.tools/mcp` ([repo](https://github.com/Illyism/awesome-tools-mcp)) | Tool search, directory submissions, and backlink verification | Related, not in `.mcp.json`: the [LinkDR agent skill](https://linkdr.com/SKILL.md) plans backlink orders and returns one checkout link, and the [GenPPT MCP](https://github.com/Illyism/genppt-mcp) turns an audit or roadmap into a `.pptx` or PDF deck. ## Companion resources - [71-point SEO launch checklist](https://il.ly/growth): free pass/fail checks, each with a test command, plus a 50-directory launch tracker. - [850+ startup, AI tool, and MCP directories](https://linkdr.com/resources/directories): filter by DR, traffic, price, and link type, with submit URLs. ## Sponsors MIT-licensed and maintained by [Ilias Ism](https://il.ly), supported by these products: | Product | What it does | | --- | --- | | [LinkDR](https://linkdr.com) | Managed backlinks at DR 30-60+. You can approve every publisher site before placement. 15% off monthly plans. | | [AI SEO Tracker](https://aiseotracker.com) | Tracks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and AI Overviews cite your brand, and which competitor pages they cite instead. | | [GenPPT](https://genppt.com) | Turns notes, reports, and PDFs into editable PowerPoint and Google Slides decks. | | [Scribiz](https://scribiz.com) | Transcribes video and audio with speaker labels, on-screen text, and chapters. Web, macOS, Android, CLI. | | [Awesome Tools](https://awesome.tools) | A curated SaaS and developer tools directory. Submit your product for a verified dofollow listing. | | [SEO Roast](https://seoroast.com) | A recorded 20-minute video teardown of your site with a 90-day plan. | | [XOutlier](https://xoutlier.com) | A free Chrome extension that finds outlier posts across 390,000+ creators on X. | ## FAQ ### What are SEO skills for AI agents? A skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md` file: instructions, checks, and output templates that teach a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Windsurf) one SEO job, such as a technical audit, a title rewrite, a content refresh, or a backlink plan. ### How do I use them in Claude Code or Cursor? Run `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills` in your project, or globally. The agent loads a skill when your prompt matches its description. You can also name it: *"Use `blog-refresher` on `content/blog/post.mdx`"*. ### Can I use them in ChatGPT, Claude.ai, or Perplexity? Yes. Open [il.ly/skills](https://il.ly/skills), pick a skill, and copy the prompt into the chat. ### What is the difference between a skill and an MCP server? A skill tells the agent how to do the job. An MCP server connects it to live data and actions: SERPs, AI citation scans, transcripts, checkouts. Most workflows here use both. ## License MIT © [Ilias Ism](https://il.ly)

End-to-end SEO workflows

The skills chain. Six that work well:

1. Ship a post with first-hand proof. dataforseo-serp (cluster and check intent) → proof-kb (add your benchmarks) → seo-blog-images → unslop-seo → internal-linking → parasite-and-pr.

2. Win buyers leaving a competitor. ahrefs-research (diff their top pages) → vs-and-alternatives → reddit-serp → honest-link-outreach.

3. Push a page-2 URL into the top 3. seo-title-optimization → blog-refresher → intro → linkdr (2-4 DR 40+ links at the refreshed URL).

4. Get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. customer-journey → aiseotracker → ai-seo-report → content-coverage.

5. Launch from DR 0. understand-customers → blitz-copy → directory-submissions and awesome-tools → blitz-seo.

6. Daily repo SEO. Run seo-autopilot on a schedule so the agent checks site health, verifies claims against recent commits, and opens PRs. Add diff-marketing weekly to turn shipped code into posts.

FAQ

What are SEO skills for AI agents?

A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file: instructions, checks, and output templates that teach a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Windsurf) one SEO job, such as a technical audit, a title rewrite, a content refresh, or a backlink plan.

How do I use them in Claude Code or Cursor?

Run npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills in your project, or globally. The agent loads a skill when your prompt matches its description. You can also name it: *"Use blog-refresher on content/blog/post.mdx"*.

Can I use them in ChatGPT, Claude.ai, or Perplexity?

Yes. Open il.ly/skills, pick a skill, and copy the prompt into the chat.

What is the difference between a skill and an MCP server?

A skill tells the agent how to do the job. An MCP server connects it to live data and actions: SERPs, AI citation scans, transcripts, checkouts. Most workflows here use both.
